//: Dev-server proxy for `npm start`, which is the LOCAL stack.
This used to target https://api.pianoml.org, so the local frontend talked to the
production API while `npm start` was setting BASE_PATH=http://localhost:8080 —
the script claimed local and the proxy delivered remote. Any endpoint that only
existed locally (uploads, profile, library) appeared to be missing.
environment.api is '/api', and requests are built as '/api' + '/api/v1/...', so
pathRewrite strips the proxy prefix and the backend receives '/api/v1/...'.
To develop against the hosted API instead, use `npm run start-remote`.
